extension.description: Shows a full-screen slideshow of photos placed in /storage/Slideshow/photos. Seconds per photo, random order and background color are configured via this addon's own Settings screen. Left/Right on the remote goes to the previous/next photo, Pause/Play pauses and resumes the auto-advance, and Back exits. Photos are always scaled to fit the current Kodi GUI resolution without cropping, against an opaque background, and Kodi's own screensaver is held off while it runs.
